question: Which of the following is a right under Article 300A?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Right to Property__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 300A

 
 
• Article 300A deals with the **Right to Property**.
 
• Article 300A states that no person shall be deprived of his property, save by the authority of law.
 
• The right to property was declined from the** Fundamental Right** after the **44th Constitutional Amendment Act, of 1978**.
 
• After the amendment, it was made a legal right under Article 300A in **PART-XII **of the Constitution.
 
• The Supreme Court reminded Government that the state had to follow the due procedure of law before taking the private property of a person.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Right to Freedom**
 It guarantees Individual rights under Articles 19 to 22
 
 

 **Right to Life**
 It ensures nobody, including the Government, can try to end your life, under Article 21
 
 

 **Right to Education**
 The act aims towards compulsory education of children between the age group of 6 years to 14 years. Under Article 21-A
